newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse closes mixed, Ashanti Goldfields down.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse closes mixed, Ashanti Goldfields down.

text.p: Worries about the world price for gold pushed down Ashanti Goldfields Co Ltd shares on the Ghana Stock Exchange, which closed marginally higher on Monday.
The GSE All-Share Index edged up by 0.65 points to 359.92 points from its 359.27 points close last Friday.
Among three equities that recorded price changes, Ashanti lost 500 cedis, the second such drop within a month, to close at 22,000 cedis. Unilever Ghana Ltd fell five cedis to 775 cedis.
Guinness Ghana Ltd was the lone gainer, up 25 cedis to 300 cedis.
Total bids outstripped offers by 3,156,030 to 1,996,360 with volume of 719,560 shares changing hands.
Analysts and traders say the market is beginning to pick up after a lull in the runup to presidential and legislative elections last month, but business remains generally slow.
